title: Get to know Bitfarms’ new CEO, Ben Gagnon
transcript_text: We have some big news at Bitfarm's. I'm Steve or Marketing Specialist and I'm here with our new CEO, Ben Gagneau. I'm sure you're just as excited as I am to learn more. So let's dive in with some questions. First, I got to ask, why did you want to go from being Chief Mining Officer to Chief Executive Officer? Yeah. Look, I've been here five years Steve. I really love this company and I've tremendous pride in both Bitfarm's and everything we've accomplished over the last couple of years. But I think more importantly, I have a really clear vision for what we as a company need to do and what we can become. And it's not only for this year, but it's for this entire avenue park all the way through the next having event in 2028. And as the architect and leader of our strategic vision and now the whole company, I really recognize and am excited to bear this responsibility of driving value creation for shareholders and improving the lives and performance of all of our employees. I'm really not afraid to do the hard work that I know needs to be done. And I'm really looking forward to leading this team into unlocking its full potential. Oh, that's great to hear. What do you like most about working at Bitfarm's? Oh, the team. For sure, it's the team. Over the last five years, I've worked with every department and every site we've had. I've got really great opportunity to get to know this company or team and our potential inside and now. And we have an incredibly intelligent, passionate and motivated group of really high performance individuals through which I have the full confidence that we can accomplish anything we set our minds to. Oh, wonderful. Well, I got to ask, how do you see Bitfarm's changing now that you're at the home? Bigger, faster, stronger, more aggressive, more dynamic, more proactive. And look, we built an incredible foundation to continue to build off of. And I envision us expanding and diversifying our portfolio with a real emphasis on US infrastructure but also into highly synergistic and complimentary businesses and revenue streams, like potentially energy generation, heat recycling, waste processing, and even HPC for AI. Thank you so much for your time. I'm sure we'll have a lot more questions for you in the future. Thanks, Dan.
